name: Effingham Lawrence
bioAdditions: Third son and seventh child of Richard Lawrence (son of Joseph, son of William & Elizabeth Smith); b. 1734; married Catharine Farmer; moved to London, commanded a British frigate, became an Elder Brother of Trinity House and a merchant at Tower Hill (S1). Children: William Effingham, John Curson, Effingham Calvert, Edward Billop and Catharine Maria (wife of Sir John Thomas Jones, Bt, Wellington's aide). 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Note: the Wikipedia article 'Effingham Lawrence' is a different man (Louisiana congressman, 1820-1878).

sources.citation: Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), pp. 48-49
